snippet.title: Fever Meme Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110070/Fever_Meme/?

Fever Meme is a self-aware game that breaks the 4th-wall more than The Stanley Parable and Undertale combined. You will never experience anything like this game. Whether or not that's a good thing is up to you. #fevermeme #indiegames #indiegame #indie #indiedev #indiedevelopers #thestanleyparable #thestanleyparableultradeluxe
